title: SR-1.07 Pinned TLS on the relay and a configured OAuth issuer
request: Closes G07: Relay client uses rejectUnauthorized:false with name pinning; the OAuth issuer is derived from the Host header. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Certificate fingerprint pinning

criteria.statement: A relay presenting a different key is refused before any request byte is sent
